letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Software Engineer role with Example Hiring Team. My background centers on reliable API and data-platform work, with an emphasis on observability, operational tradeoffs, and disciplined delivery. I currently serve as a Senior Software Engineer at Example Systems, building on software engineering experience dating to 2017.

At Sample Cloud, I implemented versioned Node.js APIs and contract tests designed to keep customer integrations working through releases. I also profiled production-like database workloads, verified query plans before adding indexes, and built an accessible React console that let users review failed jobs and retry only affected work. These experiences align closely with your need for reliable services and thoughtful recovery behavior, although my record does not explicitly confirm recovery-test ownership.

Earlier, at Demo Works, I developed Python import tools that preserved source identifiers and rejected ambiguous records for manual review. I added integration tests covering CSV exports, Unicode names, and date handling to reduce the risk of silent data corruption. A separate booking project extended this testing mindset to time-zone conversion and appointment conflicts while documenting browser support and known limitations for reproducible failures.

My technical toolkit includes Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, and OpenTelemetry. The supplied record confirms OpenTelemetry as a skill but does not document the scope of tracing work; I would welcome the opportunity to discuss that experience accurately and learn more about your tracing environment. I would bring a practical focus on reliable interfaces, testable failure handling, accessible operational tooling, and clear documentation.

Thank you for considering my application. I would value the opportunity to discuss how my background could support the team’s service reliability and observability goals.

Kind regards,
Renée Ionescu
